REVOLUTION D.F. 12
FULLY MODULAR ATX 3.1 POWER SUPPLIES
SMALL BUT POWERFUL
The Smallest* ATX 3.1 ATX Power Supply in the Market
*Based on Intel psuselector-20240301
Aligned with the sustainable principle, The REVOLUTION D.F. 12 stands out as one of the smallest PSUs available in the market, boasting a 122mm in-depth, aiming to minimize the material waste of manufacturing and packaging by up to 28.7%. It is equipped with a built-in 115mm PWM fan featuring industrial-grade dual-ball bearings and a 6-pole motor for enhanced durability and efficient cooling.
SMALL SIZE, BIG BENEFITS
Easily fit into your desired smaller PC cases.
More space for effortless cable management.
Keep the extra volume out of the way of airflow.
INTEL ATX 3.1 & 12V-2X6 CONNECTOR READY
The REVOLUTION D.F. 12 meets all the Intel ATX 3.1 standards, guaranteeing compatibility with contemporary hardware configurations. The native 12V-2x6 connector effortlessly channels up to 600W power, ensuring top-notch performance from high-end graphics cards.
PREMIUM MESH-SLEEVED CABLES
The power supply cables have been upgraded to premium mesh-sleeved cables to bring you better cable routing with their soft and bendable points for remarkable cable management. The included 27 pcs cable comb kit keeps your cables in good management and in good order.
PERFORMANCE EXCELLENCE
80 PLUS® GOLD Certified
Up to 235% Power Excursion
100% Japanese Capacitors
The REVOLUTION D.F. 12 is 80 PLUS® Gold certified with efficiency over 90% on standard loading. By wasting less energy, it reduces greenhouse gas emissions associated with electricity generation. It also produces less heat, leading to improved reliability and a longer lifespan for electronic components and devices.
The REVOLUTION D.F. 12 is designed to accommodate up to 235% power excursion, which means it can handle more than 2x its rated wattage for a short period of time, catering to your high-end graphics cards requirements and preventing the system from sagging power and possibly crashing the PC.
The REVOLUTION D.F. 12 incorporates 100% industrial-grade Japanese capacitors with high-quality materials and manufacturing processes, ensuring stable and consistent performance.
ADVANCED POWER SUPPLY FAN TECHNOLOGIES
DUST-FREEROTATION D.F. (DUST-FREE)SWITCH BUTTON FANLESSWITH 0 DB(A) 6-POLEMOTOR DUAL-BALLBEARING
PATENTED DUST-FREE ROTATION (D.F.R.) TECHNOLOGY
The power supply fan boasts the ENERMAX’s patented Dust-free Rotation (D.F.R.) self-cleaning technology with a power-on activated switch next to the power switch, enhancing system longevity by minimizing dust accumulation.
D.F. (DUST-FREE) SWITCH BUTTON
Press the D.F. switch on the power switch side to initiate the D.F.R. function whenever you want. There are two types of way for cleaning paired with semi-fanless control technology.
✔ Power Supply under 60% Load & Under-Temperature (=Fan is not spinning)
Press the switch then the fan will spin clockwise for 20 seconds and turn back to anticlockwise direction for another 20 seconds then it will stop entirely.
✔ Power Supply over 60% Load or Over-Temperature (=Fan is spinning)
If you press the D.F. switch while the fan is spinning, the fan will stop immediately and start to spin clockwise for 20 seconds, it will then turn back to the anticlockwise direction.
OPTIMAL SEMI-FANLESS CONTROL TECHNOLOGY
The built-in semi-fanless technology allows the fan to remain stopped until 50% working load or over-temperature, which minimizes noise levels and improves overall system acoustics by reducing fan noise when the cooling demand is low.
6-POLE MOTOR FAN INSIDE FOR MINIMAL VIBRATION
The REVOLUTION D.F. 12 is equipped with a 6-pole motor with 3-phase fan to provide minimal vibration, low power consumption, and an exceptionally smooth operation.
INDUSTRIAL-GRADE DUAL-BALL BEARING
The REVOLUTION D.F. 12 is equipped with a high-performance fan featuring industrial-grade dual-ball bearings, which effectively reduces unnecessary friction to optimize its performance. By incorporating these high-quality dual-ball bearings, the REVOLUTION D.F. 12 achieves enhanced stability and exceptional quality. This design not only extends the lifespan of the unit but also maximizes the performance of your system for your most demanding needs.
HEAVY-DUTY INDUSTRIAL-GRADE PROTECTIONS
Over Current Protection
Over Voltage Protection
Under Voltage Protection
Over Power Protection
Over Temperature Protection
Short Circuit Protection
CABLE AND POWER AS YOU NEED
Only connect the cable you need with fully modular design.

Notice:For users looking to put in a high-end, power-demanding GPU, please plug in the 12+4P / 6P / 6+2P PCIe connector(s) from your ENERMAX power supply to the GPU properly. This will prevent the motherboard from overloading and possibly causing any damage to your system, including your ENERMAX power supply. Once this occurs, it will be treated as improper system configuration, and any damage caused to the power supply, as a result, will not be covered under ENERMAX manufacturer’s warranty. Please refer to your motherboard & GPU’s user manuals to configure your system properly to prevent the motherboard from overloading and causing any damage to your system and your power supply.
The modular cables in the box are all compatible with your newly purchased power supply. Please only use the modular cables provided in your ENERMAX power supply package. Do NOT use other modular cables to prevent pin configuration damage to your system and your power supply.
Info for the rated current of the DC cables: The safety current is 6A per single DC wire. Please note that overloading may cause the connectors or wires meltdown and could void the warranty.
